name: Station List

business_logic: 1. Load cached station list from local storage (synced from server station master data)

2. Query local draft records (weighbridge-record/grading-record/cages-track-record) WHERE created_by = current user AND status IN (draft_ongoing, draft_paused), grouped by station type → determine hasDraft boolean per active station type
3. Render grid: is_active=true → tappable with color = merah if hasDraft else hitam/netral; is_active=false → disabled/info only
4. Render breadcrumb (Home > Production Process Activity) as tappable segments
5. Render header dengan 'Mill Smart Log' + hamburger menu (konsisten dengan Home)
6. On tap active station → navigate to Monitor screen for that station type
7. On tap disabled station → show 'belum tersedia' info, no navigation
8. On tap breadcrumb segment → navigate to corresponding route (e.g. Home)
9. On tap hamburger → open nav menu (Ganti Password, Logout)
